---
title: "Realism"
guide-section: "DSA & analysis"
---

Excel analogues: **Realism** tools and **Output 4-1 / 4-2** — forecast-error
checks, fiscal-adjustment placement, investment–growth, and fiscal-multiplier
views. Uses Baseline public / Macro series and Imported-data vintages.

Package: `lic_dsf.realism`. Does not own Chart Data or risk ratings. Output
4 panels live in `lic_dsf.output`. Public automatic debt dynamics
(`DUCIR` / `DUCGDPR` / `DUCER`) are shared DSA math in
`lic_dsf.dsa.dynamics` (re-exported from `lic_dsf.realism` for convenience).

**Edit Realism / Imported data in Excel**, save, then `load_core` +
`load_realism`.

## What you get

| Piece | Role |
|-------|------|
| `load_realism` (`lic_dsf.load`) | Imported catalog, capital, multipliers, LIC histogram, invest-growth |
| `forecast_error_panel` (`lic_dsf.output`) | Forecast error / debt-creating flows |
| `fiscal_adjustment_panel` (`lic_dsf.output`) / `place_in_lic_histogram` | 3-year adjustment vs LIC programs |
| `invest_growth_panel` (`lic_dsf.output`) | Capital stock / growth contribution |
| `fiscal_multiplier_panel` (`lic_dsf.output`) | Multiplier / underlying growth |

## Load and compute

```python
from pathlib import Path

from lic_dsf.load import load_core, load_realism
from lic_dsf.output import (
    fiscal_adjustment_panel,
    fiscal_multiplier_panel,
    placement_summary,
)
from lic_dsf.realism import (
    place_in_lic_histogram,
    projected_three_year_adjustment,
)

workbook = Path("data/lic-dsf-template-2025-08-12.xlsx")
macro, external, ext_base, pub_base = load_core(workbook)
realism = load_realism(workbook)

first = macro.inputs.first_projection_year
pd_pct = pub_base.primary_deficit_to_gdp()
projected = projected_three_year_adjustment(pd_pct, first)
placement_summary(place_in_lic_histogram(projected))
fiscal_adjustment_panel(pd_pct, first)

pb_pct = 100.0 * macro.primary_balance() / macro.gdp_lcu()
fiscal_multiplier_panel(pb_pct, macro.real_gdp_growth(), first)
```

Use `realism.imported`, `realism.capital`, `realism.multipliers`, and
`realism.invest_growth` for forecast-error / invest-growth panels (see
[`demo/realism.ipynb`](https://github.com/Teal-Insights/py-lic-dsf/blob/main/demo/realism.ipynb)).

## Excel cues

| Tool | Output |
|------|--------|
| Forecast errors / debt-creating flows | Output 4-1 area |
| Fiscal adjustment vs LIC distribution | Realism / Output 4 |
| Investment–growth | Realism capital block |
| Fiscal multiplier | Realism multiplier grid |
